resources.string: A burglar, a hazard, a disaster warning, an SOS, a new phone linked.
Everything JARVIS tells you that is not urgent.
Gentle reminders: water, a stretch, a focus break.
JARVIS opens inside Chrome, Sir. Please install or update Chrome from the Play Store, then open JARVIS again.
The Play Store did not open. Please install Chrome another way.
Link this phone to your JARVIS once, Sir. Then each line below is a choice you can make now or later.
On your laptop open JARVIS, then Integrations, Phone app, Link a phone. Confirm with your passkey and type the 8 characters it shows here.
Please type the 8 characters shown on your laptop, Sir.
JARVIS did not accept that code. Codes last 10 minutes and work once: please make a new one on your laptop.
JARVIS could not be reached. Please check the internet and try again.
Linking did not work. Please try again in a minute.
This phone is linked to JARVIS.
Alerts while the app is closed.
Steps, heart rate and sleep from Health Connect. Only daily sums leave the phone.
Your place in an SOS, only while the SOS screen is open.
New PDF, JPEG or PNG files in one folder you pick go to your vault to confirm. Android does not let apps watch the Download folder itself: share those documents to JARVIS instead.
Talk to JARVIS, and SOS, from the pull-down shade.
Partly: open Health Connect to allow the rest
Health Connect is not on this phone
Pull down the shade, tap the pencil and drag the JARVIS tiles in.
Switched off in Android\'s settings. Tap to open them.
Please allow Watch data first, Sir.
JARVIS could not be reached. It will try again later.
Without the background switch, the watch is read only while this screen is open.
What is read: steps, heart rate and sleep from Health Connect, and nothing else.
What leaves the phone: only daily sums, the day\'s steps, the lowest, average and highest heart rate, and each night\'s sleep. No single heart-rate reading is sent.
Where it is kept: sealed on your own JARVIS server, for 400 days.
How to delete it: in JARVIS open Privacy, then Watch days, then Delete (it asks for your passkey). To stop the reading, switch JARVIS off in Health Connect.
Sending to your family in %1$d seconds. Tap Cancel to stop.
Sending a TEST to your family in %1$d seconds. Tap Cancel to stop.
The Telegram message could not be sent. Please text your family or call 112.
This phone is not linked to JARVIS, so no Telegram message can go. Please text your family or call 112.
No numbers are saved for the text message yet.
Tell the same people you are safe, Sir?
They have been told you are safe.
This is a message to your family, not an emergency service. In danger, call 112. Set up Android\'s own Emergency SOS too: press the power button five times.
